title: Bathouse/Bathroom dream?
content: Today i had a dream, where i found myself in a big, empty, but unsettling bathouse? It felt dingy just like the toilets, i remember it having multiple floors underground and as i recall, it was placed in some hotel. That made me remember that i have dreamed of similar settings before. I was there alone, but constantly interupted or stressed that someone may find me out there. It was connected to the pools too from what i was thinking in the dream, but haven’t gotten there.
